asc.plainEnglish: In plain English, The ability system means: The ability system component owns activate, cost, and cooldown. The character does not.
asc.whyGame: In a real game, getting the ability system wrong shows up as broadcasting OnEffect from Tick, or also subtracting the cost by hand. the timer started at Begin Play is the repair, and the generated line `void UKitComponent::Graph_ApplyEffect_tpl_gaseffect_apply() // node:tpl_gas-effect_apply` is that repair in C++.

expansions.title: The ability system as a door
expansions.detail: If the ability system is a use, the hit calls one interface. A door, a switch, and a pickup can share it without a new cast.

expansions.title: The ability system as data
expansions.detail: Designer numbers for the ability system live on a row. a one second timer that broadcasts OnEffect, which is the fear or cost reaction reads the row instead of a literal.

expansions.title: The ability system as a listener
expansions.detail: Later systems listen for ApplyEffect. They do not broadcasting OnEffect from Tick, or also subtracting the cost by hand.
